The vendor directly providing **Vercel** at **vercel.com** is **Vercel Inc.**.

### Evidence
According to the official **Vercel Terms of Service** (vercel.com/legal/terms):
> *"Subject to these Terms of Service (this \"Agreement\"), Vercel Inc. (\"Vercel\", \"we\", \"us\" and/or \"our\") provides access to Vercel's Services. “Services” means, collectively, any products or services made available by Vercel or its affiliates..."*

This is also reinforced in their Enterprise Terms and Conditions:
> *"Vercel Inc. (\"Vercel\") provides access to Vercel's cloud platform, including, without limitation, this website, certain APIs, professional services (“Professional Services”) and other services..."*
